mikrotik_produktseite.Untertitel: Small weatherproof wireless access point with LTE antennas and miniPCI-e slot
mikrotik_produktseite.Merkmale: Automotive, IP 54, Mini PCI-e, Outdoors, PoE
mikrotik_produktseite.Beschreibung: The wAP R is a small weatherproof 2.4Ghz wireless access point with a miniPCI-e slot (so you can use your own LTE card) and LTE antennas. Unit comes with one 10/100 Ethernet LAN port for your wired devices. The weatherproof device can be mounted outside your house, in the vehicle, on your porch or anywhere else where you need wireless access from your phone or computer. It also includes a desktop stand so you can put it inside the building near a window. Unit has the several powering options - 9-30V PoE-in by Ethernet port, DC jack and automotive connector, very handy in mobile devices like car, bus or train. *) the device has no built in LTE modem, the SIM slot can only be used, if an LTE modem is installed (not included with the product).
mikrotik_produktseite.Certification: CE, FCC, IC, E-MARK, EAC, ROHS

mikrotik_handbuch.Sicherheit: This product is intended to be mounted outdoors on a pole but can also be installed indoors.
mikrotik_handbuch.Mounting: wall, ceiling, pole or MikroTik holder (desktop stand); drill hole template, steel bracket for drop ceiling, screws and wall anchors; pole with zip ties or steel clamp; Torx T20 security screw for bottom lid optional; IP54; cable openings downwards; MPE distance minimum 35 cm
mikrotik_handbuch.Bottom Lid: secured with captive screw, Philips PH2
mikrotik_handbuch.Powering: Direct-input power jack (5.5 mm outside and 2 mm inside, female, pin positive plug) accepts 9-30 V DC; Ethernet port accepts Passive PoE-In (Mode B) 9-30 V DC. The power consumption under maximum load can reach 6 W. Attach ground (earth) wire to the screw under the bottom lid.
mikrotik_handbuch.Extension slots and ports: Wireless module 2.4 GHz 802.11b/g/n; one 10/100 Ethernet port, Auto MDI/X; miniPCI-e slot for your desired modem
mikrotik_handbuch.Buttons: Reset: 5 s Konfiguration zuruecksetzen, 10 s CAP-Modus, 15 s Netinstall; vor dem Einschalten gedrueckt: Backup-RouterBOOT

mikrotik_quickguide.PoE input: The ethernet port accepts 9-30 V passive PoE power. The box contains a 24 V adapter and a PoE injector.
mikrotik_quickguide.Power jack: The DC jack (5.5 mm outside and 2 mm inside diameter, female, pin positive plug) supports 9-30 V powering, the device comes with a 24 V 0.8 A power adapter.
mikrotik_quickguide.Automotive connector: The plug has four pins: bottom left (black) is the ground, bottom right is power in (red). The upper two are reserved for future use.
mikrotik_quickguide.Leistung: Maximum power consumption at 24 V is 6 W without miniPCIe, and 8 W with full load on the miniPCIe card.
mikrotik_quickguide.Mounting: wall, ceiling or pole; drill hole template; steel bracket for dropdown ceiling tile; two screws and wall anchors
mikrotik_quickguide.Expansion: Built in 2 GHz wireless AP module; one 10/100 ethernet port Auto MDI/X, 9-30 V passive PoE; miniPCIe slot and SIM slot (can't be used separately)
mikrotik_quickguide.MiniPCIe: remove both screws below the power jack and slide out the wAP PCB board; grey uFL to MAIN, black to AUX; two SMA mounting holes next to the reset button, or SMA antennas on the bottom of the case after removing two plastic hole covers; SIM miniSIM (2FF), chip facing up, plastic latch
mikrotik_quickguide.Reset: 5 s Reset RouterOS-Konfiguration, 10 s CAP-Modus, 15 s Netinstall; vor dem Einschalten: Backup-RouterBOOT
mikrotik_quickguide.FCC: RBwAPR-2nD: FCC ID TV7WAPR2ND, IC ID 7442A-WAPR2ND; R11e-LTE: FCC ID TV7R11ELTE; 63 cm occupational / 140 cm general public; additional approved antennas WLO-2450-15 15 dBi, ODH 24-13 13 dBi, SA 24-90-17-WB 17 dBi, WLP-2450-20 20 dBi, DC 24-HD-PFIP 24 dBi

mikrotik_zubehoer.text: R11e-LTE or R11e-LTE-US miniPCIe card can be installed to wAP R unit. R11e-LTE / R11e-LTE-US cards have two U.fl connectors, where ACSMAUFL pigtails can be connected. ACSMAUFL pigtails have SMA connectors, that fit nicely in special mounting places of wAP R. SMASMA cables then can be used to connect ACSMAUFL pigtails to mANT LTE 5o antenna with SMA connectors.
